company_info.company_description: " TCK Solar is your premium partner for high-end, all-electric solutions.Founded on the principles of honesty, quality and expertise, our tailored solutions reflect the unique needs of each person and property to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.What sets us apart is not just our experience, but our ability to simplify the technologies and options so you feel 100% confident with your choice/s.Everyone in our team is honest and trustworthy, and we live by an unwavering commitment to offering products with industry leading warranties and 24/7 monitoring.At our core is a belief in clean power and leaving a healthy planet to our children, plus continually setting the standards in our industry.From custom-designed systems to in-house installation teams, we take pride in providing outstanding customer service and delivering solutions that exceed expectations.Our team is here to help and we look forward to assisting you with your own personalised design solution."

reviews.review_description: Prompt response, performed site visit. didn't try to sell the largest system, installation went smoothly.

The quotation process was smooth, with all of my various questions being addressed one way or another. We were surprised at how quickly the installation was completed being less than 3 weeks after the deposit was paid. Installation took a single day and went smoothly and was carried out by a team of 5 people who seemed to do a competent job in a competent manner. So far, the panels seem to be performing well, and to me are better than I expected. We are still waiting for the power company to make the necessary changes to the meter so that we can get paid for excess generation.

Tck actually had on site visit and advised the best kW to get accord to my usage - also checked the roof to ensure the best place for panels.  All parts of service were punctual.  Only down side was the weird accounting system that continually quoted to wrong balance and on calling was explained the complicated system and how it is calculated.  None of this was evident in the invoice so really did my head in trying to understand and pay correct balance.
Timo and the crew were very professional and the installers were great.

TCK Solar are one of the few companies that come to visit you, and provide an evaluation of your consumption habits and offer solutions to maximising your energy efficiency (not just by installing solar) as well as future proofing the design. They are certainly not the cheapest, but offer the highest quality products available and an in-house installation team. I went for a 7kW system utilising Sunpower Maxeon 6 435W panels coupled with Enphase microinverters - offering numerous benefits including individual panel monitoring and significantly longer warranties compared to string inverter designs. TCK were happy to accommodate a roof restoration at the same time, by pre-installing the wiring and roof rails prior to roof painting, then returning to complete the installation following the restoration. It has been running faultlessly for a month so far and i'm loving the 'Enlighten' App by Enphase to monitor my generation/consumption including individual panel performance. If power prices continue to rise, I may look at adding a battery in the coming months.

We have an inner city townhouse with a very small roof as 1/3 of our top storey is an outside deck area.Timo came around and inspected the roof and recommended that for such a small area with issues with shading from things already installed on the roof, that we should go with panels with micro inverters on each panel.The installation process was very smooth, with the TCK team coming to install the rails on one day, and the next day installing the panels.A very long cable run was needed from the roof to the fuse box.  This was done externally and looks great.I found the communication from TCK to be top notch, with questions answered promptly, and everyone turned up when they said they would.
Very happy with the process and would recommend to anyone looking for a quality system

TVK have a very fast and comprehensive quotation turnaround - 24 hours in my case. Their crew turned up early in fact and a 16 panel system installed and running in a day and a half. Very responsive head office. Proactive monitoring of the system post install including picking up that the solar monitoring add on wasn’t quite working. They returned a few days later and fixed it. 3 weeks after the install all retailer paperwork and processes were completed. Very happy and have since recommended them to two more family members.

Everything about this company was fantastic. The best part was when they went back on the roof to add a panel to ensure the system looked symmetrical and more efficient.Customer Service that always gets back to you within a business hour of receiving your emails. If you are on the fence between companies, select this one.

My Solar System was installed by TCK Solar on the Ballerina Peninsula in June of 2018.I am writing this in November 2019 and have had the system running for 18 months. Timo excels at providing you with only top notch equipment down to the brackets that fix you panels on the roof. No shortcuts.Initially the system would cut out and on consistently. But this was due to over voltage issues caused by the grid connections. Timo & Co. assisted in getting Powercore to fix the issue and once it was corrected the system has worked perfectly ever since.My system is 6.5kW (18 Sunpower panels) with a Solaredge Inverter and Powerwall 2.Peek performance: 45kWh for a summer day and generated just under 10,000 kWh for the past 12 months. Since Sept 2018 I have not paid a single power bill. On the contrary AGL owed me around $450 in accumulated credit just before heading into the 4 winter months starting in May, but I still generated enough electricity that my credits where only chewed up by the connection costs alone. And I was still in credit $300 at the start of the new credit generation cycle which starts in the month of September for me and ends in April.

My Solar System was installed by TCK Solar in September 2019.  I'm located in Inner Northern Melbourne and have a two storey house with a gabled, low pitch roof.  The northern section of the roof was specifically designed as a 'hip roof' so I could have solar panels facing north.The 7.36 kW Solar System consists of 23 x SunPower 320 Watt Panels, SolarEdge Power Optimisers and a SolarEdge Inverter.  I have 6 panels facing east, 10 panels facing north and 7 panels facing west.   All flush to the roof.  The panels came with a 25 year Product and Performance Warranty and the Inverter has a 12 year manufacturer warranty.  The SunPower Panels are definitely on the expensive side however just about every internet review that I found indicated that they are one of the (â€¦ if not the) best solar panels on the market.  The SolarEdge Inverter also gets good reviews and I know 4 people that have a SolarEdge Inverter in their system and they have all indicated that they have had no issues with it.The quote process was pretty straight forward.  Timo came out to my house and worked through everything with me and gave me a few options to work with.  The Pro Forma Invoice was also good as it laid out quite clearly what the solar system consisted of, the overall price and what TCK Solar would be delivering.  Once I paid my deposit Melissa from TCK Solar Customer Service contacted me and I was able to organise an install time a week later.A 2 day install was organised.  This was due to the number of panels involved and the difficulty of the site.  I'm on a very narrow block and access to the roof could only be done from the rear of the house so everything had to be carted out the back before it could be lifted up to the roof.  The morning of the first day was very wet and windy however TCK Solar were fantastic and did a great job in tough conditions.  They also kept me in the loop as to what was going on and worked solidly over the 2 days.  On time to start both days and worked until the days job was complete.  The electrician on day 2 was also great.  He also kept me in the loop and did a great job with the tidy ness of the external conduit cabling.  The job was finished about 4pm on the second day.  I got our drone up above the roof before sunset so we could have a look at our newly installed solar panels.  Everything was ready.On day 1 there wasn't a cloud in the sky and my new solar system generated 35 KWh for the entire day.  It's only mid September so I would expect this to increase closer to the 21st of December.  Perhaps 45 KWh per day or more ... ?  I'll have to wait and see.  I've been able to logon to both my SolarEdge account to see how much power my panels are generating (live data) as well as my CITIPOWER account to see my daily electricity usage (the next day).  I am now essentially not using electricity from the grid from about an hour after sunrise to an hour before sunset.  This should save me quite a bit of money in the long run.  The panels also immediately changed family behaviour.  The dishwasher and washing machine are now only operated in daylight hours.It's very early days however it is looking like a fantastic investment for me ... and money well spent.  TCK Solar have done a great overall job and have been fantastic to work with.  When there was any sort of issue, like my Inverter not pairing properly with my router, they managed to sort it out very quickly.The only negatives.  The lack of some sort of 'exit' document once the installation was complete.  The Pro Forma Invoice was great as it highlighted exactly what was being delivered however there was nothing to sign off on once it was delivered.  The Feed In Tariff process is also a bit laborious.  It was certainly explained to me verbally however it would have been nice to have this process somewhere in the Pro Forma Invoice or exit document.   I'll take the 35 KWh generated on day one over these two 'negatives' any day though!I'm now aiming to give an annual update to this review to see just how good this system turns out to be.
Great system which was installed in 2009 and paid for itself in about 6 years.  Couldn't be happier

Our system turns off a lot because the energy supplier (United Energy) puts 253 volts on the incoming line.Our system turns off when the voltage goes over 252 volts. But comes back on when the voltage dropsTCK is working to get United to fix this.

We installed our system in 2011 and I just realised it will have paid us back in full by mid 2017.I also just realised I had never got around to writing a review to thank Tim & Timo for this really great system.It has performed flawlessly all these years thanks I believe to the German Engineering and their expertise.We are on the premium 66 cent rebate tariff which runs until 2024.After that we will be looking to add on a Battery Storage system which will be funded by the $3,000 plus return per year we are getting from the premium feed in tariff.Two of my bosses also put the same system in and they say it is the best investment ever.I just checked and noticed you don't have any battery storage on your website so I hope you will be selling them by 2024.I hope this review is helpful to anyone looking to purchase a solar system as it can be overwhelming and one of the biggest problems I found was not knowing who I could trust with honest reliable advice.I found Tim & Timo to be honest and trustworthy.Tim was under a bit of stress at the time and lacked a little in keeping me informed as things progressed but he is a really nice person and they did deliver on time.I should add also they gave me a surprise phone call two years after installation for the free service they promised which I had completely forgotten about.Thank you once again Tim & Timo I will be in touch for a Battery Storage as soon as the premium Tariff ends.
First class service and excellent quality product.  Personal attention was fantastic.

I first signed up with Sun Connect based in WA but ended up cancelling my order as I found the sales people extremely pushy and aggressive. I have no reason to suspect they do not have a quality product but found their sales methods not to my liking.I eventually went with TCK Solar and am happy with the specification and quality of their system although it is a little more expensive than other available systems.

I was after a system that fitted my scope of requirements.  That was the basis of the choice of the successful tender.  Very specific component requirements and how they were to be installed.  TCK solar was th eonly one that catered to such specific specification requirements.

We are monitoring our panels daily and think when the days are sunnier and warmer we will be making power beyond our expectations.  So far, we are very happy with the output considering we are still in winter.  At this stage, considering its almost the end of August and the wettest winter we have experienced in many years, we are more than happy with our product.  Today, being 26/8/12, our panels produced 19.40kw.  Very happy with that!!!  Roll on summer!
Thanks for the information you provided in your emails and web site I found this benificial in making this important decision.

All of the quotes supplied offered me the cheapest solar panel they have others but no offers were made, my supplier only deals in one solar Solon highest quality I believe available.There should not be a price difference on colourbond roof and tiles
